project.description: Name of the project, or a folder to migrate (e.g. ./libs). Without it the whole workspace is migrated

fix.description: Whether overwrite icons prefixes or simply inform in console

replacementDataPath.description: JSON file with the icon mapping, an array of { "from": "kbq-<old>", "to": "kbq-<new>" }, relative to the project root or the folder. Without it the built-in mapping is used
